Subject: Your breach of contract matter - CS(COMM) 2463/2022

Dear Mr. Patel,

Thank you for meeting us on 15 June 2022 about your dispute with Banyan Infotech Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, the claim must be filed as a commercial suit. The matter is listed before the Hubballi Commercial Court.

Our advice is to complete pre-institution mediation before filing the commercial suit. Please collect the mediation request and the statement of accounts and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
